occupations.cat: Refuse workers and other elementary workers

n.story:
Your role is evolving from a manual sorter to a systems overseer and technical troubleshooter. As computer vision and robotic arms take over the repetitive task of identifying and pulling plastics or metals from a fast-moving conveyor belt, your focus will shift toward managing the 'exceptions.' You will spend your day monitoring AI-driven sorting systems, intervening when the technology encounters a novel material or a mechanical jam that requires human dexterity and problem-solving.

Beyond the belt, your role will become more analytical. You will use AI to ensure 100% compliance with ever-changing environmental legislation, using automated dashboards to track waste types and scrap quality in real-time. Instead of just moving material, you will be optimizing the flow of the entire facility, using predictive maintenance tools to fix machines before they break. You are moving from being a 'cog in the machine' to being the technician who ensures the machine runs at peak efficiency.
n.adv: Focus on learning the basics of industrial robotics and data dashboards; the future of recycling is less about 'picking' and more about 'programming' and 'fixing'.
